title: React Testing Library
description: Testing utilities for React that encourage good testing practices.

data.text: React Testing Library (RTL) is a set of utilities for testing React components. It encourages testing from the user's perspective by querying DOM elements as a user would, rather than relying on implementation details.

data.title: Testing a Component
data.content: Test a counter component using React Testing Library.

terms.definition: Methods like getByRole and getByText for finding DOM elements.
Simulating real user interactions like clicking, typing, and selecting.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: RTL tests from the user's perspective
Queries mirror how users interact with the page
Works with Jest, Vitest, and other runners
data.takeaway: React Testing Library promotes testing practices that lead to more maintainable tests.
